visibility.overflow_policy: shorten-or-split-copy-before-layout; do not reduce body below baseline to force-fit

transition.invariant: At transition i -> i+1, item i stays fully visible throughout and after the transition as the previous item; only item i-1 may leave.
transition.retention: Item i may leave only when item i+2 arrives.
transition.hold_duration: TBD: validate against lyric density and reading time

validation: Static post-transition concept inspected; temporal behavior not implemented or verified.

bilingual_lyrics.english_visibility: large high-contrast readable subtitle, not a tiny footnote
bilingual_lyrics.display_rule: Keep each complete English lyric and its corresponding Chinese translation together; long lines may wrap without dropping either language.
bilingual_lyrics.timing: TBD: bilingual synchronization not implemented; this is a static sample

required_order: referenced meme / term / source context when applicable
how the lyric uses it: reference, pun, contrast or joke
annotation_card.quote_role: Each note is self-contained after the corresponding left-side subtitle changes.
annotation_card.previous_retention: Keep both the previous lyric quote and its complete explanation, not only its heading.
annotation_card.claim_policy: Separate source-backed facts from editorial interpretation; mark uncertain origins TBD instead of inventing references.
annotation_card.readability: Keep prior body-size baseline; shorten or split notes instead of shrinking text further. Motion and reading duration remain unverified.
